 "data": "@startuml
title Use Case Diagram - Connect Repository (Technical Debt Analysis System)

left to right direction

actor Developer
actor \"GitHub Repository Service\" as GitHub

rectangle \"Technical Debt Analysis System\" {

 usecase \"Connect Repository\" as Connect
 usecase \"Select Repository\" as Select
 usecase \"Authorize Repository Access\" as Authorize
 usecase \"Fetch Repository Data\" as Fetch
 usecase \"Start Repository Scan\" as Scan

}

Developer --> Connect

Connect --> Select : <<include>>
Connect --> Authorize : <<include>>
Connect --> Fetch : <<include>>

GitHub --> Authorize
GitHub --> Fetch

Scan ..> Connect : <<extend>>

 "data": "@startuml
title Use Case Diagram - Run Repository Scan (Technical Debt Analysis System)

left to right direction

actor Developer
actor \"Static Analysis Engine\" as Engine

rectangle \"Technical Debt Analysis System\" {

 usecase \"Run Repository Scan\" as RunScan
 usecase \"Select Repository\" as SelectRepo
 usecase \"Retrieve Source Code\" as Retrieve
 usecase \"Execute Static Analysis\" as Analysis
 usecase \"Calculate Technical Debt Metrics\" as Calculate
 usecase \"Store Scan Results\" as Store
 usecase \"Handle Scan Failure\" as Failure

}

Developer --> RunScan

RunScan --> SelectRepo : <<include>>
RunScan --> Retrieve : <<include>>
RunScan --> Analysis : <<include>>
RunScan --> Calculate : <<include>>

pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TB

 subgraph U[\"USER - browser (Next.js client)\"]
 U1[\"Click Scan
 phase = idle\"]
 U2[\"Poll status every 1 s
 phase = running NN%\"]
 U3[\"Click Stop
 (optional)\"]
 U4[\"Dashboard renders
 phase = done\"]
 end

 subgraph A[\"API PROCESS - FastAPI (stateless, replicable)\"]
 A1[\"Read branch head SHA\"]
 A2{\"head SHA =
 last scanned SHA?\"}
 A3[\"INSERT SCAN
 phase = queued\"]
 A4[\"Return scanId\"]
 A5[\"Serve phase + progress\"]
 A6[\"Revoke job
 phase = idle\"]
 A7[\"ScoringEngine.score
 findings x active profile\"]
 end

 subgraph Q[\"BROKER - Redis (private network)\"]
 Q1([\"Job queue + progress state\"])
 end

 subgraph W[\"WORKER PROCESS - Celery (1..n, scaled horizontally)\"]
 W1[\"git clone at SHA
 phase = running\"]
 W2[\"Extract: Lizard, PyDriller,
 comments at that SHA\"]
 W3[\"Rule engine:
 rule + security findings\"]
 W4[\"Persist snapshot\"]
 W5[\"phase = done\"]
 WE[\"phase = error\"]
 end

 subgraph M[\"ML PROCESS - inference service\"]
 M1[\"ML-1 SATD classify\"]
 M2[\"ML-2 per-file risk\"]
 end

 subgraph D[\"DATABASE - PostgreSQL (RLS)\"]
 D1[(\"SCAN\")]
 D2[(\"FINDING + FILE_SCORE\")]
 end

 U1 -->|HTTPS POST /api/repos/repoId/scan| A1
 A1 --> A2
 A2 -->|yes: skip re-scan| A7
 A2 -->|no| A3
 A3 -->|SQL over TLS| D1
 A3 -->|Redis message: enqueue scanId| Q1
 A3 --> A4
 A4 -->|HTTPS scanId + phase| U2
 Q1 -->|Redis message: deliver scanId| W1
 W1 --> W2
 W2 --> W3
 W2 -->|HTTP: comment batch + feature vectors| M1
 M1 --> M2
 M2 -->|HTTP: labels + risk scores| W4
 W3 --> W4
 W4 -->|SQL over TLS: append-only INSERT| D2
 W4 --> W5
 W5 -->|SQL over TLS: UPDATE phase| D1
 W1 -->|Redis: publish NN%| Q1
 U2 -->|HTTPS GET .../scan/scanId| A5
 A5 -->|Redis: read progress| Q1
 U3 -.->|HTTPS POST .../scan/scanId/stop| A6
 A6 -.->|Redis: revoke| Q1
 W2 -.->|clone or extract fails| WE
 M2 -.->|ML unreachable: rule findings only| W4
 U4 -->|HTTPS GET /api/repos/repoId/health| A7
 A7 -->|SQL over TLS: read stored facts| D2
 A7 -->|HealthReport| U4
",

</diagram> <diagram id="p4auyLae0ocjUmyJHJ8M" name="Scan_Sequence"> <mxGraphModel dx="4120" dy="2384" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Dev as Developer
 participant UI as :DashboardUI
 participant SC as :ScanControl
 participant API as api:FastAPI
 participant GH as gh:GitHub
 participant Q as broker:Redis
 participant W as worker:CeleryTask
 participant EX as :Extractors(Lizard,PyDriller)
 participant RE as :RuleEngine
 participant ML as ml:Service(ML-1,ML-2)
 participant SS as :ScoringEngine
 participant DB as db:PostgreSQL

 Dev->>UI: click Scan
 UI->>SC: start(repoId, branch)
 SC->>API: POST /api/repos/{repoId}/scan
 activate API

 API->>GH: GET repo metadata (ETag conditional)
 GH-->>API: head commit SHA
 API->>DB: SELECT SHA of last scan where phase = done
 DB-->>API: last successful SHA
 Note over API: SHA differs, so a scan is needed

 API->>DB: INSERT SCAN (phase = queued)
 API->>Q: enqueue(scanId)
 API-->>SC: 202 { scanId, phase: queued }
 deactivate API

 Q->>W: deliver(scanId)
 activate W
 W->>DB: UPDATE SCAN (phase = running)

 par worker runs the pipeline
 W->>GH: git clone at SHA (no REST quota)
 GH-->>W: working tree and history
 W->>EX: extract(tree at SHA)
 EX-->>W: product metrics, process metrics, comments
 W->>RE: detect(product metrics)
 RE-->>W: rule and security findings
 W->>ML: classify(comments)
 ML-->>W: SATD findings (category only)
 W->>ML: risk(product + process metrics)
 ML-->>W: risk_score per file
 Note over W,ML: the two calls are independent<br/>neither model reads the other's output
 W->>Q: publish progress NN%
 and client polls independently
 loop every 1 s until the phase is terminal
 SC->>API: GET /api/repos/{repoId}/scan/{scanId}
 API->>DB: read phase
 API->>Q: read progress
 API-->>SC: { phase, progress }
 end
 end

 W->>DB: INSERT FINDING, FILE_SCORE (append-only)
 W->>DB: UPDATE SCAN (phase = done)
 deactivate W

 SC->>API: GET /api/repos/{repoId}/health?branch=...
 activate API
 API->>DB: read facts of latest scan where phase = done
 API->>SS: score(findings, active profile)
 SS-->>API: priorities, file debt, health, grade, breakdown
 API-->>UI: HealthReport
 deactivate API
 UI-->>Dev: render dashboard
",

 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Dev as Developer
 participant UI as :ProfilesUI
 participant API as api:FastAPI
 participant SS as :ScoringEngine
 participant DB as db:PostgreSQL

 UI->>API: GET /api/profiles/active
 activate API
 API->>DB: read WORKSPACE.active_profile_id, SCORE_PROFILE
 DB-->>API: six weights, trust_s
 API-->>UI: ScoreProfile
 deactivate API
 Note over UI: sliders open showing what is in force

 Dev->>UI: pick preset (Balanced default) or drag sliders
 Note over Dev,UI: client state only<br/>no request is sent while dragging
 Dev->>UI: click Apply

 UI->>API: PUT /api/profiles/active { six weights, trust_s }
 activate API
 API->>API: clamp weights 0.1-3.0, trust_s 0-1
 API->>DB: UPDATE SCORE_PROFILE, SET WORKSPACE.active_profile_id
 Note over API,DB: one transaction, seven numbers
 DB-->>API: stored profile
 API-->>UI: ScoreProfile (as stored, after clamping)
 deactivate API

 UI->>API: GET /api/repos/{repoId}/health?branch=...
 activate API
 Note over UI,API: same URL as before<br/>no profile parameter
 API->>DB: read facts of latest scan where phase = done
 API->>SS: score(findings, active profile)
 SS-->>API: priorities, file debt, health, grade, trend
 API-->>UI: HealthReport
 UI-->>Dev: re-ordered list, new grade, same findings
",
 "config": null

 "data": "@startuml
title CodeSage-AI - Implementation View: Subsystem Overview Diagram

' =========================================================
' Styling & Theme
' =========================================================
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam defaultFontName \"Segoe UI\", Arial, sans-serif
skinparam defaultFontSize 12
skinparam backgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam nodesep 40
skinparam ranksep 45

' Layer styling
skinparam package {
 BackgroundColor #F8FAFC
 BorderColor #334155
 FontColor #0F172A
 FontSize 13
 FontStyle bold
}

skinparam component {
 BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
 BorderColor #475569
 FontColor #1E293B
}

skinparam database {
 BackgroundColor #FFFBEB
 BorderColor #D97706
 FontColor #92400E
}

' =========================================================
' SUBSYSTEM COMPONENTS
' =========================================================
package \"1. Presentation Layer\" {
 [apps/web (Next.js)\nPages, Components, Hooks] as Web
}

package \"2. Application / Domain Layer\" {
 [apps/api (FastAPI)\nREST Routers & Domain Services] as API
 [Scan Orchestration\nCelery Worker Tasks] as Celery
 [apps/ml (Python / scikit-learn)\nSATD & Risk Inference] as ML
}

package \"3. Data Layer\" {
 database \"PostgreSQL\nTenants, Snapshots, Findings\" as PG
}

' Layout alignment
Web -[hidden]down-> API
API -[hidden]down-> Celery
Celery -[hidden]down-> PG

' =========================================================
' DATA FLOW & RELATIONSHIPS
' =========================================================
Web ..> API : \"HTTPS / REST\n(lib/types Contract)\"

API ..> Celery : \"Enqueues Scan Tasks\"
Celery ..> ML : \"SATD & Risk Features\"

API ..> PG : \"Reads Health Snapshots\"
Celery ..> PG : \"Writes Findings & Scores\"

@enduml
",
 "config": null
